Export a mable of JDemetra+ models as a new workspace

Source: R/workspace.R
export_jws.Rd

Writes a new workspace readable by the JDemetra+ graphical interface, with one SA-item per model: raw series, estimation specification, reference specification, and the modelling context (calendars and regressors). A workspace has a single context: regressors of different models that share the same name but have different values (e.g. xreg(col) in several series) are renamed <name>_<sap>_<series>, in the context and in the specifications. Results, comments, priorities and links to data providers are not exported; the series are stored as static data.

Usage

export_jws(mb, file, replace = FALSE, sap = "sap", series = "series")

Arguments

mb

A mable of models fitted with X13() or TRAMOSEATS().

file

Path of the workspace (xml master file) to create.

replace

Replace the workspace if file already exists. By default an existing file is never overwritten.

sap, series

Names of the key columns giving the SA-processing and the SA-item. Without them, a single SA-processing is created and the SA-item names are built from the other keys.

Value

file, invisibly.

See also

import_jws()

Examples

mb <- model(as_tsibble(AirPassengers), sa = X13(value))
export_jws(mb, tempfile(fileext = ".xml"))
